title: A new result that contradicts one already held
plain: It never deletes the old insight. It may add a note beside it, and it asks a person to decide.

messages.text: Update on *Invite your travel arranger*: after a data fix the effect is now *-3.1 bookings/day*, with 8 to 1 odds against the variant. The earlier +9.5 should be disregarded.
